verdict.rationale: Veriff's API returns structured decision data via the session decision endpoint and decision webhooks, including approved/declined/resubmission reasons, plus separate webhooks for watchlist/PEP-sanctions and event progress signals that an automated flow can branch on programmatically (not just via UI). This is clearly machine-consumable (JSON webhook payloads, pollable REST endpoint, HMAC-verifiable), suitable for agentic decisioning rather than manual-only review — missing for 10: no explicit documented JSON schema/example payload for decision reason codes or risk-score granularity, and no third-party/independent confirmation of real-world branching use.
